text: 10 OVERDOSAGE No symptoms of overdose with CEPROTIN have been reported. The maximum infusion rate administered in clinical studies were doses of up to 600 IU/kg body weight (BW)/day (150 IU/kg BW every 6 hours) of CEPROTIN. There have been no overdosages of CEPROTIN reported during clinical studies. In long-term prophylactic treatment of doses up to 291.7 IU/kg BW/day, no adverse events were reported.
